failure: Failure: The selection counterexample proves that a nonzero statistic need not identify a noncentral force. The observed statistics do not establish or exclude the external-field mechanism, and source data are not a homogeneous, selection-calibrated sample. The identity eliminates a leading hidden-depth term only under its observation assumptions.
interface: Interface: The cancellation is exact only for the stated shear observation model, fixed beta and stationary unselected ensemble. The report's application to actual astrometry is not an instrument-level theorem; finite-angle geometry, time-varying observer geometry, systemic-motion estimates, sample selection, ordinary Galactic tides, encounters and companions require control.

claims.title: A projected-velocity identity cancels leading depth shear, but selection mimics torque
